title: Standards for Administrative Dispositions against Performance Inspection Agents (Related to Article 15(1))
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rule of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act [Attached Table 4] <Amended 2021.9.7>

Standards for Administrative Dispositions against Performance Inspection Agents (Related to Article 15(1))

| Violation | Applicable statutory provision | Standard for disposition |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Obtaining registration under Article 27 of the Act by false or improper means | Article 29(1)1 of the Act | Revocation of registration |
| 2. Failing to meet the registration standards for agents under Article 27(1) of the Act | Article 29(1)2 of the Act | Suspension of business for 2 months (revocation of registration where the violation occurs 2 or more times within 5 years) |
| 3. Coming to fall under any subparagraph of Article 28 of the Act (excluding the case where, if an executive officer of a corporation falls under subparagraph 5 of Article 28 of the Act, a replacement for that officer is appointed within 3 months) | Article 29(1)3 of the Act | Revocation of registration |
| 4. Lending a performance inspection agent registration certificate or the registered name to another person | Article 29(1)4 of the Act | Suspension of business for 2 months (revocation of registration where the violation occurs 2 or more times within 5 years) |
| 5. Preparing false performance inspection results or conducting a performance inspection by improper means | Article 29(1)5 of the Act | Revocation of registration |
| 6. Refusing or evading a performance inspection without justifiable grounds | Article 29(1)6 of the Act | Revocation of registration |
